title: LDL Protocol for Sample Preparation and Analysis
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yrcfv2w

steps.title: Precipitate HDL
steps.instruction: Precipitate the HDL fraction from the sample using precipitation buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 25µl 2X precipitation buffer to 25µl of sample using a positive displacement pipet.
Vortex and let sit at room temperature (RT) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect HDL Fraction
steps.instruction: Pipet the supernatant into a new tube; this constitutes the HDL fraction.

steps.title: Prepare Assay Plate
steps.instruction: Dispense calibrator and samples into the plate, ensuring no bubbles are introduced to avoid interference with the plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µl of calibrator and sample to each well.

steps.title: Perform TC or TG Assay
steps.instruction: React the samples with TC or TG reagent and measure absorbance.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µl of TC or TG reagent to each well.
If samples are hemolyzed, pipet a blank well with 5µl sample and 300µl PBS.

steps.title: Calculate Sample Concentrations
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of unknown samples using the calibrator and blank readings.

substeps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings.
Calculate unknown samples as: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration.

steps.title: Determine LDL/VLDL Value
steps.instruction: Adjust for HDL dilution and calculate the final LDL/VLDL value.

substeps.instruction: Multiply HDL sample values by 2 to account for the 1/2 dilution.
Subtract the adjusted HDL value from the total triglyceride or cholesterol value to obtain the LDL/VLDL value.
